fullBio: Maggie Black is a piano based singer songwriter from Chicago, whose eclectic style draws from influences such as Suzanne Vega, Jeff Buckley, Fiona Apple, Leonard Cohen, and Amy Winehouse. She is currently recording her first album on an 8 track with the help of the musical maverick Dev Jana. If you ask her about this project she might retreat into the nearest snail's shell and raise a sign that reads 'please come back when I'm done,' but she promises it'll be done soon.
notableHighlights: After apearances at Crooner's, White Squirrel, Green Room, Analog Avalon Festival, and others, Maggie is currently wrapping her debut full length 'Daggers'
